existing_group_assignments.rationale: Mitochondrial Complex I inhibition is the same event as 'Inhibition, NADH-ubiquinone oxidoreductase (complex I)', and the group already pairs it with the binding event.
Binding of plastoquinone B site in D1 protein of photosystem II concerns the same object as photosystem II inhibition, but binding is a distinct process.
Decreased glycolysis is the same endpoint as 'Decrease, Glycolysis' and opposite to 'Increase, Glycolysis'.
Increase in lipid degradation is closely related to fatty acid beta-oxidation, but it is not clearly the same endpoint, so it is better left out.

new_groups.rationale: Activation of the oxidative stress pathway and elevated mitochondrial ROS describe oxidative stress at different levels of specificity and compartment.
General disrupted energy metabolism and specific glycolysis or OXPHOS changes.
